Red Crab is the best
Sep 2026 • Family
Red Crab, where I went because I wanted to eat seafood in Nha Trang!

The store was clean and the staff were friendly, so I could eat comfortably. The crab dish, which is the representative menu, was satisfying because the meat was plump and the sauce was delicious. The shrimp and seafood menu items were fresh, and the atmosphere was good for visiting with family or friends.

Considering the prices in tourist areas, it was reasonable, and if you like seafood, it's a place worth visiting at least once. If you want to enjoy a delicious seafood meal while traveling in Nha Trang, I recommend it!
